issues.t: Fuel pump can shut off and cut power (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls or suddenly loses power while driving and may not restart.
issues.why: The fuel pump can stop working while the van is moving. Recall 23V-444 covered 2021-2023 vans and 23V-881 added more 2022-2023 vans.
issues.next: If the engine cuts out, get safely off the road. Check your VIN for both recalls; the fuel pump is replaced for free.

issues.t: Fuel hoses to the engine can come loose and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A strong fuel smell around the van or fuel dripping under the engine area.
issues.why: The upper and lower fuel hose connections at the engine may not be tight, so fuel can leak near hot parts. This is a fire risk.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Dealers inspect the connections and replace hoses and clamps as needed for free.

issues.t: Engine bay fuel hose can leak at its connections (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell or a wet spot under the engine.
issues.why: An earlier recall found that a fuel hose in the engine compartment could leak where it connects.
issues.next: Stop driving if you smell fuel. Dealers replace the hose and clamp for free.

issues.t: Power steering assist can cut out from bad welds in the rack (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes very heavy, often with a steering warning on the dash.
issues.why: Pins inside the electric power steering rack may have been welded poorly and lose contact, switching off the power assist.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. You can still steer, but it takes much more effort. Get the free rack replacement done if it is open on your VIN.

issues.t: Power steering motor bolts can corrode and break (recall)
issues.sym: Heavy steering, possibly with a clunk from the steering or a warning light.
issues.why: Aluminum bolts holding the power steering motor can corrode and snap in road-salt states, reducing or removing steering assist.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers swap the aluminum bolts for steel ones for free.

issues.t: Power steering sensor can fail and switch off assist (recall)
issues.sym: A steering warning light and suddenly heavy steering.
issues.why: A sensor inside the electric power steering unit may be faulty, shutting off the power assist.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. Check your VIN. Dealers replace the steering unit for free.

issues.t: Brake fluid reservoir can come loose and leak (recall)
issues.sym: Low brake fluid warning, fluid under the hood, or a soft brake pedal.
issues.why: The brake fluid reservoir may be mounted wrong and can detach, letting fluid leak out.
issues.next: If the brake pedal sinks, feels soft or goes closer to the floor, or a red brake warning comes on, slow down gently, use a lower gear, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on: call for a tow. If the brake warning comes on or the pedal feels soft, stop driving and have it towed. Dealers fix the mounting for free.

issues.t: Front wheel bearing may not be seated correctly (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding, humming or play from a front wheel. In the worst case a wheel could come off.
issues.why: The front wheel bearings may not have been seated correctly at the factory.
issues.next: Stop driving if a front wheel feels loose or noisy. Dealers inspect and reposition the bearing retaining rings for free.

issues.t: Transmission support bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk or vibration from under the van when accelerating or shifting.
issues.why: The transmission mount bolts may not have been tightened properly, which can damage the driveshaft.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers check and replace the bolts for free.

issues.t: Driveshaft bolts can loosen at the transmission (recall)
issues.sym: Vibration, clunking or a knocking noise from under the van.
issues.why: Bolts holding the driveshaft to the transmission flange may work loose. A driveshaft that separates can cause loss of drive power.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers replace the flange and bolts for free.

issues.t: Driveshaft may not be attached to its center bearing correctly (recall)
issues.sym: Excess vibration while driving.
issues.why: On some 2019 vans the driveshaft may not be fastened to its intermediate bearing properly, wearing the joint.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers inspect the driveshaft and replace it if needed for free.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not vent properly (recall)
issues.sym: No warning before a crash.
issues.why: Some vans built in September 2016 got a passenger airbag with the wrong tether part, so it may not deploy as designed.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers replace the passenger airbag for free.

issues.t: Backup battery under the passenger seat may lack a cover (recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing. A burning smell under the front passenger seat would be a warning sign.
issues.why: The compartment for the backup battery under the passenger seat may be missing its cover, so the seat or a metal object could short the battery and start a fire.
issues.next: Keep metal items out from under the seat and check your VIN. Dealers add a cover for free.

issues.t: Rearview camera image can freeze (recall)
issues.sym: The backup camera picture freezes or shows an old image when reversing.
issues.why: A faulty memory chip in the rearview camera can freeze the image.
issues.next: Do not rely on the camera until it is fixed; use your mirrors. Dealers replace the camera for free.

issues.t: Rearview camera picture may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: The center screen stays blank or shows no camera image when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Electrical connections at the infotainment unit may be loose, so the camera image does not show.
issues.next: Back up using your mirrors and check your VIN. Dealers inspect and repair the connection for free.

issues.t: Blind spot monitor not supported by the installed parts (recall)
issues.sym: Blind spot assist does not work even though the van was ordered with it.
issues.why: Some vans got an instrument cluster and steering wheel that do not support blind spot monitoring.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers install the correct cluster and steering wheel for free.

issues.t: Emergency call system may send the wrong location (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom in daily driving.
issues.why: Software in the communication module may report the wrong location to emergency responders after a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers update the software for free.

issues.t: Emergency call system can lose its network connection (recall)
issues.sym: The emergency call (SOS) system may show a fault or fail to connect.
issues.why: A SIM card software error can stop the module from connecting to the mobile network.
issues.next: Check your VIN. The fix is a free software update, over the air or at a dealer.

issues.t: Tire load labels list the wrong capacity (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom, but the van may be loaded beyond what its tires can safely carry.
issues.why: The tire and loading labels listed an incorrect maximum combined load, and some vans had tires that did not match.
issues.next: Do not overload the van. Dealers install corrected labels and replace tires if needed for free.

issues.t: Van left the plant without a final safety inspection (recall)
issues.sym: No specific symptom.
issues.why: Some vans left the factory or reassembly plant before a final check of safety-related parts and bolted joints.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers or the plant complete the inspection and fix anything found for free.

issues.t: Front head restraint cover can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: A rattle from the front headrest, or the headrest padding shifts.
issues.why: Spring pins in the front head restraints may be missing or mounted wrong, so the padding carrier can come off.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Dealers replace the head restraints for free.

issues.t: Brake line fittings may leak on right-hand-drive vans (recall)
issues.sym: Brake fluid leaking near the axles, a low fluid warning or a soft pedal.
issues.why: On right-hand-drive vans, fittings between the steel brake lines and the brake hoses may not have been installed correctly.
issues.next: If the brake pedal sinks, feels soft or goes closer to the floor, or a red brake warning comes on, slow down gently, use a lower gear, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on: call for a tow. If you have a right-hand-drive van, check your VIN. Dealers check and correct the fittings for free.

issues.t: Airbag control unit can get wet on right-hand-drive vans (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on.
issues.why: Water can collect on the airbag control unit in right-hand-drive vans, which may stop the airbags from deploying properly. The recall also covers 2020 right-hand-drive vans.
issues.next: If you have a right-hand-drive van, check your VIN. Dealers install a protective cover for free.
